2 Topology
This chapter explains how a vehicle’s physical System Topology is being modeled in AUTOSAR (Example: Figure 2.1). A topology is formed by a number of ECUInstances that are interconnected to each other in order to form ensembles of ECUs and CommunicationClusters, which are further detailed by providing information on bus-speciﬁc properties.
